name: substack
description: Connect to Substack through its official MCP server.

research.notes: Substack's official MCP is read-only publication analytics (subscribers, post performance, revenue, retention) and works only for an admin of a Bestseller publication; it cannot read the person's reading list, Notes or profile, so readers get nothing from it. Discovery 2026-10-09: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256, token auth none or client_secret_basic, authorization server substack.com, scopes mcp:read and mcp.user.read.

probe.reason: HTTP 401, sign-in methods and S256 PKCE confirmed; no account tested
